text: The purpose of this report is to inform the Board regarding a settlement of monies owed by Dakin West Inc., who has subleased the premises to various franchisees who operate INS Markets, to Toronto Parking Authority for the use of the premises located at 33 Queen Street East, Unit 2, Toronto, Ontario.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (October 4, 2024) from the City Solicitor and the President, Toronto Parking Authority remain confidential in its entirety, as it is pertains to litigation or potential litigation that affects Toronto Parking Authority and contains advice or communications that are subject to solicitor-client privilege.
